[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Ritor''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] nobleman who possessed expertise in the administration of interrogation facilities. When [[Ilm Vaz-Weplinn]], an [[Assistant-Deputy Viceprex]] in the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector's]] [[Security Police/Legends|Security Division]], proposed a collaboration between the Security Division and the [[Imperial Correctional Facilities Ministry]] on the [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] project to [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Chawkroft]], she responded to his proposal with a list of requirements that such a prison would entail. One of these necessities would be a fully staffed interrogation facility. To fulfill this requirement, Chawkroft suggested to Vaz-Weplinn that he could contact [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Ritor if he needed any help in determining the specific needs of such a facility.
